description: This file implements hardware information retrieval functions for the XB3 platform, including functions to get hardware version, serial number, MAC address, manufacturer, model, and capabilities. It reads data from cached files and executes scripts to gather system info.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreLine
methods.description: Checks if a line from the info file is a comment or blank.

methods.name: copyAndTrimBuffer
methods.description: Copies characters from source to destination, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: loadFromArm
methods.description: Parses the output file to load hardware info into memory.

methods.name: initXb3
methods.description: Initializes hardware info by loading data if not already loaded.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_get_macaddr
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from system file.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_get_capability
methods.description: Checks if a capability is supported.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_set_capability
methods.description: Enables a capability (not supported in this implementation).

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_get_rem_dev_info
methods.description: Retrieves info about removable devices (not implemented).
